dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Big brother, this place is kinda narrow. We can't race like this...

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: It's fine. The adults say that boats can sail wherever there's water. Why don't we make small boats? You know, like the aquabuses!

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Ooh, nice! And then we can race using those boats, can't we?

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: Good idea. Now, as for the materials... Should we go ask Mr. Hugues?

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Must we? Every time we ask him to fix a toy, he'll deliver something completely different back to us.

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: But isn't that a good thing? If he can turn a boat into an aircraft, I'd even work for him, really!
